title: not-uber-service - live
description: What the platform is doing right now: trips finishing, position events arriving, where demand is, and how often the route prediction was wrong. Every panel reads the Distributed tables, so it sees both shards. The hourly summary is filled per node, so every query against it sums first and divides afterwards.

panels.title: Trips completed (last hour)
panels.description: Counted from the hourly summary table, which is filled automatically as trip events arrive.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(completed_trips) AS trips FROM nus.trip_stats_hourly WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour(now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR)

panels.title: Revenue (last hour)
panels.description: Final fares of completed trips, surge included.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(revenue) AS revenue FROM nus.trip_stats_hourly WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour(now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR)

panels.title: Nobody available (last hour)
panels.description: Share of trips that found no driver at all. This is the number that says the fleet is too small for the hour - the fix is more drivers or fewer requests, not more containers.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100 * countIf(status = 'no_driver_found') / greatest(uniqExact(trip_id), 1) AS pct FROM nus.trip_events WHERE event_time >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

panels.title: Trips slower than predicted (24h)
panels.description: How often the real trip took longer than the route calculation promised. A number that climbs means the traffic factors are out of date.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100 * sum(overrun_trips) / greatest(sum(completed_trips), 1) AS pct FROM nus.trip_stats_hourly WHERE hour >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

panels.title: Average surge (last hour)
panels.description: Surge added up divided by the number of trips - never an average of averages, because the summary table holds one row per node.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(surge_sum) / greatest(sum(completed_trips), 1) AS avg_surge FROM nus.trip_stats_hourly WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour(now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR)

panels.title: Warehouse is behind by
panels.description: How old the newest trip event in ClickHouse is. Green means the pipeline is keeping up. If this climbs without stopping, something between Kafka and the sink has stalled - check 'make lag' before anything else.

targets.rawSql: SELECT dateDiff('second', max(event_time), now()) AS seconds_behind FROM nus.trip_events

panels.title: Position events per minute
panels.description: Driver and rider position reports arriving in ClickHouse. This is the best single sign that the pipeline is alive end to end. The two streams are deliberately separate: a windscreen mount and a phone in a pocket report at different rates.

defaults.noValue: no position events in this range

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(event_time) AS time, 'drivers' AS series, count() AS events FROM nus.driver_positions WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT toStartOfMinute(event_time) AS time, 'riders' AS series, count() AS events FROM nus.rider_positions WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Busiest zones
panels.description: The newest demand score per zone within the dashboard's time range. This is the same number that sets the surge price for trips starting there. Empty means city-service has published no scores in the range - it is the only writer of these rows.

defaults.noValue: no demand scores in this range - is city-service running?

targets.rawSql: SELECT zone_id, argMax(demand_score, computed_at) AS demand, argMax(open_requests, computed_at) AS waiting_riders, argMax(available_drivers, computed_at) AS free_drivers, argMax(surge_multiplier, computed_at) AS surge FROM nus.hotspot_history WHERE $__timeFilter(computed_at) GROUP BY zone_id ORDER BY demand DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: How trips ended
panels.description: Every trip reaches one of four endings. Completed is the one that earns money; the other three are the ways demand goes unserved. Watch the proportions rather than the heights - a rising red band means requests are arriving that the fleet cannot reach.

defaults.noValue: no trip events in this range

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, 'completed' AS series, count() AS trips FROM nus.trip_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND status = 'completed' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, 'cancelled by passenger' AS series, count() AS trips FROM nus.trip_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND status = 'cancelled_by_passenger' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, 'cancelled by driver' AS series, count() AS trips FROM nus.trip_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND status = 'cancelled_by_driver' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time, 'no driver found' AS series, count() AS trips FROM nus.trip_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND status = 'no_driver_found' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
